```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(openmeteo)
library(arrow)
library(paletteer)
library(ggrepel)
library(scales)
library(tidyclust)

options(scipen = 999, digits = 4)

theme_set(theme_bw())
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

location <- "Pittsburgh, PA"

get_weather_data <- function(location, start, end) {
  weather_history(
    location = location,
    start = start,
    end = end,
    daily = weather_variables()$daily_history_vars
  ) |>
    mutate(location = location, .before = 1)
}

get_weather_data <- slowly(get_weather_data, rate_delay(30))

weather_target <- tibble(
  location = location,
  start = c("1940-01-01", "1980-01-01"),
  end = c("1979-12-31", "2026-09-19")
)

weather_data <- weather_target |>
  mutate(data = pmap(list(location, start, end), get_weather_data))

weather_data <- pmap(weather_list, ~ get_weather_data(start = ..1, end = ..2))

names(weather_data)

weather_data <- list_rbind(weather_data)

weather_data |>
  count(date) |>
  filter(n > 1)

```

```{r}
weather_data <- read_parquet(
  "posts/pittsburgh_weather_pca/post_data/weather_data.parquet"
) |>
  mutate(
    decade = year(date) %/% 10,
    decade = str_c(decade, "0's"),
    year = year(date),
    yday = yday(date),
    month = month(date, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
glimpse(weather_data)

weather_data |>

```

```{r}
drop_bad_cols <- function(x) {
  bad_cols <- x |>
    pivot_longer(
      cols = everything(),
      names_to = "column_name",
      values_to = "value"
    ) |>
    summarize(is_constant = n_distinct(value) == 1, .by = column_name) |>
    filter(is_constant == TRUE) |>
    distinct(column_name) |>
    pull(column_name)

  print(str_c("dropping ", str_c(bad_cols, collapse = ", ")))

  x <- select(x, -all_of(bad_cols))
}
```

```{r}
glimpse(weather_data)

pca_inputs <- weather_data |>
  select(-c(year, yday, decade, month, daily_weather_code)) |>
  select(where(is.numeric)) |>
  drop_bad_cols()

glimpse(pca_inputs)

pca_fit <- prcomp(pca_inputs, scale = TRUE)
```

```{r}
pca_values <- pca_fit |>
  tidy(matrix = "eigenvalues")

pca_values |>
  ggplot(aes(PC, percent)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:nrow(pca_values)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = percent_format(),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.01))
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

weather_data_pca <- pca_fit |>
  augment(weather_data) |>
  rename_with(~ str_replace(.x, "^.fittedPC", "pc")) |>
  select(all_of(names(weather_data)), pc1:pc5)

glimpse(weather_data_pca)
```

```{r}
weather_data_pca |>
  ggplot(aes(pc1, pc2, color = month)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = .1) +
  scale_color_paletteer_d("jcolors::pal12") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1))) +
  coord_fixed()

weather_data_pca |>
  ggplot(aes(pc1, pc3, color = month)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = .1) +
  scale_color_paletteer_d("jcolors::pal12") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1))) +
  coord_fixed()

weather_data_pca |>
  ggplot(aes(pc2, pc3, color = month)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = .1) +
  scale_color_paletteer_d("jcolors::pal12") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1))) +
  coord_fixed()

weather_data_pca |>
  select(month, pc1:pc5) |>
  pivot_longer(-c(month, pc1)) |>
  mutate(name = fct_inorder(name)) |>
  ggplot(aes(pc1, value, color = month)) +
  geom_point(alpha = .1, size = .5) +
  facet_wrap(vars(name), scales = "free") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1)))
```

```{r}
# define arrow style for plotting
arrow_style <- arrow(
  angle = 20,
  ends = "first",
  type = "closed",
  length = grid::unit(8, "pt")
)

# plot rotation matrix
pca_rot <- pca_fit |>
  tidy(matrix = "rotation") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = "PC", names_prefix = "PC", values_from = "value") |>
  rename_with(str_to_lower) |>
  select(column, pc1:pc5)

pca_rot |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -column, names_to = "pc", values_to = "pc_value") |>
  group_by(pc) |>
  slice_max(order_by = abs(pc_value), n = 5) |>
  mutate(id = row_number()) |>
  ungroup() |>
  print(n = Inf)

pc_labels <- list(
  pc1 = "Higher temperatures, lower soil moisture",
  pc2 = "Higher humidity and more rain",
  pc3 = "Higher wind, lower atmospheric pressure",
  pc4 = "Lower soil moisture, less shortwave radiation",
  pc5 = "Less preciptation (rain/snow), some wind direction"
)

pc_labels$pc1

pc_label <- function(x) {
  pluck(pc_labels, x)
}

pc_label("pc1")
```

```{r}
graph_pca_rot <- function(pca_df, x, y) {
  pca_df |>
    mutate(text = str_replace_all(column, "_", " ") |> str_wrap(16)) |>
    ggplot(aes(.data[[x]], .data[[y]])) +
    geom_segment(xend = 0, yend = 0, arrow = arrow_style) +
    geom_label(
      aes(label = text),
      size = 3
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = .2)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = .2)) +
    labs(x = pc_label(x), y = pc_label(y))
}

pca_rot |>
  graph_pca_rot("pc1", "pc2")

pca_rot |>
  graph_pca_rot("pc1", "pc3")

pca_rot |>
  graph_pca_rot("pc1", "pc4")
```

```{r}
weather_data_pca_time <- weather_data_pca |>
  select(date, month, decade, yday, year, starts_with("pc"))

quantile_df <- function(x, probs = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) {
  tibble(
    val = quantile(x, probs, na.rm = TRUE),
    quant = probs
  )
}

historical_range <- weather_data_pca_time |>
  filter(year(date) < 2000) |>
  select(date, yday, pc1:pc5) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("pc")) |>
  reframe(quantile_df(value), .by = c(yday, name)) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = quant, values_from = val, names_prefix = "pct_") |>
  arrange(name, yday)

historical_range

weather_data_pca_time |>
  select(date, decade, pc1:pc5) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("pc")) |>
  ggplot(aes(date, value, color = name)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(vars(decade), ncol = 1, scales = "free_x")
```

```{r}
weather_data_pca_time |>
  select(yday, year, decade, pc1:pc5) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("pc")) |>
  ggplot(aes(yday, value, group = year)) +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = historical_range,
    aes(x = yday, ymin = pct_0.25, ymax = pct_0.75),
    alpha = .3,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = decade, color = decade), lwd = .5) +
  facet_wrap(vars(name), ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Decadal PC value vs. 1980-2000 historical range (25-65 percentile)",
    x = "Day of year",
    y = "PCA value",
    color = "Decade"
  )
```

```{r}
weather_data_pca_time |>

  geom_smooth(color = "black") +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
```

### Clustering

```{r}
# test multiple clustering algorithms

methods <- c(
  "ward.D",
  "ward.D2",
  "single",
  "complete",
  "average",
  "mcquitty",
  "median",
  "centroid"
)

#methods <- c("ward.D2", "centroid")

cluster_specs <- map(
  methods,
  ~ hier_clust(
    num_clusters = 4,
    linkage_method = .x
  )
) |>
  set_names(methods)

cluster_specs

fit_cluster <- function(x) {
  x |>
    fit(
      ~.,
      data = weather_data_pca_time |>
        filter(date < "2026-01-01") |>
        select(pc1:pc5) |>
        slice_sample(prop = .2)
    )
}

fitted_clusters <- cluster_specs |>
  map(fit_cluster)

names(fitted_clusters)
```

```{r}
# base R plotting
plot_tree <- function(x) {
  x$fit |> plot(labels = FALSE)
}

length(fitted_clusters)
par(mfrow = c(2, 4))

fitted_clusters |>
  walk(plot_tree)

dev.off()
```

```{r}
# ggraph
library(ggraph)
library(tidygraph)
library(patchwork)

method_tbl <- tibble(method = methods, cluster_fit = fitted_clusters)

method_tbl |>
  filter(method == "ward.D2") |>
  pull(cluster_fit) |>
  pluck(1) |>
  pluck("fit") |>
  as.dendrogram() |>
  as_tbl_graph() |>
  filter(height > 10) |>
  ggraph(layout = "dendrogram", height = height) +
  geom_edge_elbow()

get_dendrogram <- function(x) {
  x |>
    pluck("fit") |>
    as.dendrogram()
}

plot_dendrogram <- function(x, method, height_cut = 0) {
  cluster_method <- x |>
    as_tbl_graph() |>
    filter(height > height_cut) |>
    ggraph(layout = "dendrogram", height = height) +
    geom_edge_elbow() +
    labs(title = method)
}

plot_dendrogram <- possibly(plot_dendrogram)

method_tbl <- method_tbl |>
  mutate(
    dendrogram = map(cluster_fit, get_dendrogram),
    plot = pmap(list(dendrogram, method), plot_dendrogram)
  )

method_tbl

method_tbl |>
  filter(method == "median") |>
  pull(plot)

compare_methods_plot <- method_tbl |>
  #filter(method != "single") |>
  pull(plot) |>
  wrap_plots(ncol = 3)

compare_methods_plot
```

```{r}
cluster_summary <- cluster_assignments |>
  summarize(
    avg_start = mean(min(yday)),
    avg_end = mean(max(yday)),
    days = n(),
    .by = c(.cluster, year)
  ) |>
  left_join(cluster_labels)

cluster_summary |>

  geom_area() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_pal)

cluster_summary |>

  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = value, color = .cluster_label)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(vars(name), scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cluster_pal)
```
